# PPPoE Discovery (`pppoe_discovery`)

- **Layer**: L2 (data link)
- **Header**: variable length
- **Notes**: [L2 control protocols](../../protocols/l2-control.md)

## Reached from

| Lower layer | Selector | Value |
|---|---|---|
| [`ethernet2`](ethernet2.md) | `ethertype` | 34915 (0x8863) |

## Fields

| Field | Type | Default | Auto | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `version` | `uint(4)` | `1` |   | PPPoE protocol version (1). |
| `type` | `uint(4)` | `1` |   | PPPoE type (1). |
| `code` | `enum(8)` | `9` (padi) |   | PPPoE code (PADI / PADO / PADR / PADS / PADT, 0 = session data). |
| `session_id` | `uint(16)` | `0` |   | PPPoE session identifier. |
| `length` | `uint(16)` |   | Length of the header in octets (`-6`) | Length of the PPPoE payload, in octets (Auto). |
| `tags` | `tlv` — `length` octets |   |   | PPPoE discovery TAGs (16-bit type, 16-bit length). |

### `tags`

- Type 16 bits, length 16 bits.
- The length counts the value only.
- Unknown types are kept as raw value octets.
